note: Hand-edited source of truth. Star counts live in catalog/stars.json (generated). Never type numbers here.

entries.author: Jesse Vincent (obra)
entries.title: Superpowers
entries.summary: An opinionated software-development methodology delivered as composable skills: brainstorm, plan, TDD, debug, review, ship. Session hooks make the agent actually use them.
entries.flagshipWhy: Forces intent and requirements exploration before any creative work. The entry point to the whole methodology.
entries.whyIncluded: Most-starred skills repo. Broadest harness support of any entry (13+ agents).

entries.author: Matt Pocock
entries.title: Skills for Real Engineers
entries.summary: Small, composable engineering skills straight from Matt's .agents directory. Explicitly against process-owning frameworks.
entries.flagshipWhy: Interrogates you to close the alignment gap before building, then writes a shared-language CONTEXT.md and ADRs.

install.note: Install via ONE path only. The upstream README warns against installing both the plugin and the npx copy.

entries.whyIncluded: Second most-starred. Pushed most recently of the ten.

entries.author: multica-ai (formerly forrestchang)
entries.title: Andrej Karpathy Skills
entries.summary: A single skill distilled from Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls: think first, simplicity, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.
entries.licenseNote: No LICENSE file in the repo. We link only.
entries.flagshipWhy: Four rules that measurably reduce over-engineering.
entries.whyIncluded: Third most-starred; the canonical behavioral-guidelines skill.

entries.author: Anthropic
entries.title: Anthropic Agent Skills
entries.summary: The official reference collection, the Agent Skills spec, and the skill template. Home of skill-creator and mcp-builder.
entries.licenseNote: docx, pdf, pptx and xlsx are all-rights-reserved and may not be redistributed. We link only; nothing is copied.
entries.flagshipWhy: Scaffolds and validates new skills. Apache-2.0.

install.note: Not in our marketplace: the repo root has no plugin.json; use the command above.

entries.author: nextlevelbuilder
entries.title: UI/UX Pro Max
entries.summary: Design intelligence for building professional UI across platforms: 192 reasoning rules, 79 searchable styles, a design-system generator.
entries.licenseNote: Requires Python 3 for its local search script (stdlib only, no network).
entries.flagshipWhy: The umbrella design skill; design-system is the v2 headline.

install.cli: npm i -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude

entries.whyIncluded: Most-starred design skill; its own CLI supports about 20 agents.

entries.author: Julius Brussee
entries.title: Caveman
entries.summary: Cuts about 65% of output tokens by making the agent talk like a caveman while keeping technical accuracy. Plus subagent presets and memory-file compression.
entries.licenseNote: "Caveman" and the rock logo are trademarks of Julius Brussee. The optional CLI sends telemetry by default (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 disables it).
entries.flagshipWhy: The namesake compression mode with lite, full and ultra intensities.

install.claudePlugin: claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman

entries.whyIncluded: The token-efficiency skill everyone else copies.

entries.author: Addy Osmani
entries.title: Agent Skills by Addy Osmani
entries.summary: Production-grade engineering skills organized as a lifecycle: define, plan, build, verify, review, ship. Includes slash commands and agent personas.
entries.licenseNote: Per-skill npx install drops the shared references/ dir (upstream issue #361). Install the whole repo.
entries.flagshipWhy: Spec before code; the head of the documented lifecycle.
entries.whyIncluded: The most complete lifecycle collection; clean MIT.

entries.author: Leonxlnx
entries.title: Taste Skill
entries.summary: Gives your AI good taste: stops generic frontend slop with brief inference, variance/motion/density dials, and a design-system map.

entries.author: Composio
entries.title: Awesome Claude Skills
entries.summary: A curated awesome-list of about 180 skills plus 800+ app-automation skills for Composio's MCP gateway.
entries.licenseNote: No LICENSE file. Contains vendored copies of Anthropic's restricted document skills. We link only.
entries.flagshipWhy: Lets the agent take real actions across 1000+ apps via Composio.

install.note: Not in our marketplace: the repo root has no plugin.json; use the command above.

entries.whyIncluded: The largest discovery list in the ecosystem.

entries.author: ayghri
entries.title: I Have ADHD
entries.summary: Ten output rules that stop the agent burying the answer: lead with the next action, number steps, cap lists at five, no preamble.
entries.flagshipWhy: The only skill here about the shape of answers, and it helps everyone, not only ADHD users.

install.claudePlugin: claude plugin marketplace add ayghri/i-have-adhd && claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd

entries.whyIncluded: Fastest-growing single skill of 2026; packaged for seven harnesses.
